name: @pipeworx/mcp-latam-validate

tools.name: validate_clabe
tools.description: Validate a Mexican CLABE (Clave Bancaria Estandarizada, the 18-digit interbank account number used for SPEI transfers). Checks the control-digit checksum and decodes the bank code, plaza (branch city) code, and account number. Resolves the bank name for major Mexican banks (BBVA, Banorte, Santander, Banamex, Banco Azteca, STP, Nu, Mercado Pago, ...). Pure computation — accepts spaces or dashes in the input.

clabe.description: The 18-digit CLABE, e.g. "002010077777777771". Spaces and dashes are allowed.

tools.name: validate_cnpj
tools.description: Validate a Brazilian CNPJ (Cadastro Nacional da Pessoa Jurídica, the 14-character company tax ID) and look up the company registration: legal name (razão social), trade name, CNAE activity, address, registration status (situação cadastral), and partners (QSA). Checksum supports both the classic numeric format and the alphanumeric CNPJ introduced in 2026. Punctuation (12.345.678/0001-95) is accepted. Set skip_lookup to validate the checksum only.

skip_lookup.description: If true, only run the checksum and skip the BrasilAPI company-registration lookup. Default false.

tools.name: validate_cpf
tools.description: Validate a Brazilian CPF (Cadastro de Pessoas Físicas, the 11-digit personal tax ID) checksum. Pure computation, no lookup — returns whether the two check digits are correct and the formatted form. Punctuation (123.456.789-09) is accepted.

tools.name: brasil_cep
tools.description: Look up a Brazilian CEP (postal code) and return the address: street, neighborhood, city, and state, with coordinates when available. Example: CEP 01310-100 → Avenida Paulista, Bela Vista, São Paulo, SP.

tools.name: brasil_banks
tools.description: List Brazilian banks (COMPE code, ISPB, and name) from the central-bank registry, optionally filtered by name or code. Use to resolve a bank code from a boleto or PIX/TED transfer to the institution name, e.g. code 1 → Banco do Brasil, 260 → Nubank.

search.description: Filter by bank name substring (case-insensitive), e.g. "nubank" or "itau".

code.description: Exact COMPE bank code to look up, e.g. 341 for Itaú.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-latam-validate forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the latam-validate pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
